title: P300 dataset BI2012 from a "Brain Invaders" experiment
description: EEG recordings from 25 healthy volunteers playing Brain Invaders, a visual P300 brain-computer interface inspired by the video game Space Invaders. Data were recorded with 16 electrodes at GIPSA-lab (Grenoble, France) in 2012. The design combines a training session with online sessions of varying distractor configurations, with Target and NonTarget flash events.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a NeXus-32 amplifier (MindMedia/TMSi) at 128 Hz from 16 wet Ag/AgCl electrodes (10-20 layout) using OpenVibe, with a hardware common average reference and ground at FZ. In the training session, a Target alien was chosen randomly on each repetition: 8 Targets with 8 repetitions each gave 128 Target and 640 non-Target flashes. Each repetition consisted of 12 flashes of groups of 6 aliens (2 Target, 10 non-Target). The online session had three levels with different distractor configurations, counter-balanced across subjects.
